bio: To anyone that asks, Ranme is just Arami’s best friend – even to Arami herself. But in truth, Ranme is a friend and a bodyguard both. She was sent to protect Arami and her ancestral blades, and was paid a fortune for her trouble. Too much, in fact, and Ranme questions why – and who hired her.
